EntitlementValue.description: Exactly one of: a number (`value`), `unlimited`, or a boolean (`enabled`) for feature flags.
EntitlementValue.title: EntitlementValue

Sensitive.description:
Body for destructive / sensitive actions: a recorded reason and a typed confirmation of the
target (e.g. the organization slug), so a stray click or replayed request cannot trigger them.
Sensitive.title: Sensitive

WorkspaceSetup.description:
Optional starting workspace for a new company: blank (default), a template version, or a copy of another company's
configuration (never its documents, users or permissions). Everything stays editable and independent afterwards.
WorkspaceSetup.title: WorkspaceSetup

info.description: Shared cloud backend. Tenant realm: /api/v1/*. Platform realm: /api/v1/platform/*.
info.title: Artify Co-Accountant API

post.description: The invitee refuses. The link stops working and the organization sees the invitation as declined.

patch.description:
Edit the company PROFILE (names, registration, contact). Accounting settings have their own endpoint and
permission; lifecycle (archive, restore, activate, deactivate) has its own too.

get.description: Who was assigned, changed or removed, by whom and when (from the append-only audit log).

patch.description:
Change type, responsibility or the assignment window. Setting `ends_on` in the past ends the person's access to
the company from that day; the row stays as history of who was assigned.

get.description:
The record that OWNS this company's configuration. Phase 4 attaches workspace structure, categories,
folders, fields, templates, workflows and folder mappings to it; in Phase 3 it only says nothing is configured.

Authenticated, audited streaming of the stored file (Range supported). `inline` applies only to PDF and images; every
other type is always an attachment. The file is never executed or transformed.
Creation, modification, lifecycle, settings, assignment and membership events of this company.

patch.description:
Edit this company's accounting settings. They never propagate to, or inherit from, another company or the
organization. The base currency can only change while nothing has been configured for the company (later
phases will attach data denominated in it).

post.description:
Activate / deactivate / archive / restore. Nothing is deleted: archived companies keep all their data and
free their subscription slot; restoring needs a free slot again.

get.description: The caller's view of one company's workspace: only nodes they may view, with what they may do on each.

post.description:
Copy another company's CONFIGURATION (structure, categories, fields, naming and filing rules). Never documents,
users, permissions or money. The copy is independent immediately.
Validate document metadata against the fields that apply to a category/folder. Nothing is stored.
Dry run: which rule would win for these attributes? Nothing is filed or moved (that arrives with documents).

Render a file name with sample values. Storage and overwriting are Phase 6; this only shows what the rule would
produce. The original file name is returned separately and never altered.
Explain what another member could do (administrators use it to verify a configuration).

Bring structure, categories, fields and rules back to a recorded revision WITHOUT deleting anything (later items
are archived). Permission grants are not restored. `dry_run` reports the effect and changes nothing.

Deep-copy a template version into this company with new ids. The company keeps only a provenance note: later
template changes never reach it.

get.description:
Distribution contract for Desktop/Mobile: ONLY active, non-archived targets the caller may upload to, with the
categories that file there. Nothing is hard-coded; an empty workspace returns empty lists.

post.description:
Bind the caller's CURRENT session to one of their own ACTIVE devices and record activity (also the heartbeat).
A revoked or foreign device answers 404, so a revoked installation cannot re-attach a new session to itself.

patch.description: Change your own display name or language. E-mail and roles are not editable here.

post.description: Needs the current password. Every OTHER session of the user is signed out; this one continues.

patch.description:
Edit the basic profile (display name, locale). Legal identity, type, country, currency and
status are not editable here: they change through Super Admin / support processes.

get.description:
Professional staff (accountant, assistant accountant, staff) with their assigned companies and workload.
The professional profile (job title, licence) is separate from the authorization role shown in `role`.
Assignment lists show only companies the viewer may see.

Organization activity (the customer's own audit log). Platform-internal logs are never part of it; Artify
support activity appears here only because it is mirrored into the customer's log (see support policy).

All company-accountant assignments the viewer may see, filterable by company, person and whether the
assignment window is currently open.

post.description:
Create a company with its profile, its OWN accounting settings, its configuration-ownership record and
(optionally) its first accountant assignments, atomically. Nothing is copied from the organization or from
another company, and no default sections, folders or categories are created.

get.description:
Searchable, filterable, paginated company directory. `status=open` means active or inactive (not archived).
Rows are limited by row-level security to the companies the caller may see.

post.description: Issue a NEW secret link (the old one stops working) and a fresh expiry for a pending invitation.

patch.description:
Change a member's status and/or role. Safety rules: only a firm owner may grant or remove
the firm-owner role; the last firm owner can neither be demoted nor deactivated; nobody changes
their own role; roles that count against limit.accountants are guarded; assignments end when a
member stops being an accountant/staff member.

Professional details (job title, phone, licence). They are descriptive only and never grant or limit access:
the organization role does. A person may edit their own; `member_profiles.manage` edits anyone's.

post.description:
The approved way to hand an organization over: the current owner (MFA-verified, typing the organization slug)
makes another ACTIVE member the firm owner and becomes a practice administrator in the same transaction. The
organization therefore never has zero owners, and the last owner can never be removed any other way.

patch.description:
Organization-level contact, regional and notification settings. These never overwrite any company's own
currency, financial year, VAT or configuration (each company owns those). The organization's name, display
name and language are changed through `PATCH /orgs/{id}` (owner only).

get.description:
The organization's plan, status and entitlements exactly as the platform configured them. Customers cannot
change any of it; limits are enforced by the backend, never by this page.

post.description: Save a company's workspace (or a supplied definition) as a reusable organization template. Configuration only.

get.description:
One time-ordered feed of platform-level events: registrations, subscription changes, administrative
actions and support requests.
Sign-ins and actions performed by one administrator (from the append-only platform audit).

post.description: Signed manual adjustment (credit < 0, debit > 0) with a mandatory reason. The invoice total is never edited.
Record money Artify actually received (entered by an administrator). Overpayment is rejected.

get.description:
Every key plans can configure. `enforced_now` is false for keys whose feature does not exist yet:
the value can be set today and starts being enforced when the feature ships.

post.description: Suspension makes the organization read-only (Phase 1 behaviour); data is preserved.
A deactivated plan cannot be assigned to new subscriptions; existing ones are unaffected.
Publish a new immutable version. Existing subscriptions keep the version they use.
The requester can always withdraw their own request/grant; revoking someone else's needs platform.support.revoke.

get.description:
Usage against limits per organization. Current values are the maintained usage counters; metrics that
are not metered yet show as such. Scans at most 500 organizations per request.
